    FAQ

    Frequently Asked Questions

    Evaluate your security needs to determine the best lock for your home or business. So, consider factors, such as the property value, crime rate, and the level of access control needed.

    Rekeying involves modifying the pin configuration inside a lock so that it works with a new key, while the old key becomes ineffective. Rekeying a lock doesn’t compromise or improve the security of your lock.

    At times, a broken lock can be fixed. However, in many cases, replacement makes more sense. Whether to replace the key or fix it will depend on the lock.

    A master lock is one that functions with a different set of keys. The change key is designed to open only its specific lock, while the master key can unlock multiple locks.

    It depends on what you would want to protect. A high-security lock is essential to keep your home or business safe and secure. It will make your loved ones or family feel protected.
